text: #717, step 3 of #667's plan, recorded at #720's merge. Refines D-0362 and keeps D-0345, D-0351 and D-0355. A project's .invariant/reader.json no longer repeats its comparison: it is an ordinary version-1 reader with comparison_ref {version 1, file comparison.json, fingerprint}, and .invariant/comparison.json holds the only copy. Reading the project's reader resolves only that fixed sibling, takes only a regular unlinked file whose complete contents and fingerprint validate, and rebuilds the same in-memory reader; a missing, malformed, unsupported or mismatched reference is refused, never replaced. Historical inline readers still load, any sibling beside one must agree with it, and a sibling never adds a comparison to a reader without one. Proposals, formalization records, factory markers, receipts and receipt reader companions stay self-contained. A revision's previous/ keeps derived evidence once, in proposal.json, beside editable model, include and view sources that carry no checker authority. Comparison.Validated returns detached canonical evidence, and Validate delegates to it. Each Proposal.ValidateReader recomputes the comparison once against the current candidate and checks Target.baseline and comparison_baseline with that result; standalone validation rechecks mutable inputs on every call. One helper, Comparison.Qualifications, gives check feedback, comparison Markdown and SVG, receipts and dashboard messages the same caveats, and one rule, tla.ValidIncludeName, judges sibling include names. Canonical comparison bytes and proposal, lock, reader and verification identities are unchanged. The build's benchmark put a 500-state validation at 23.4 ms and 39 MB, down from 62.5 ms and 102 MB. The merger ran the pinned-TLC check, preview and comparison integration tests on #720's head, and they passed.
